_note: Where the protagonist can be sent next (a mission objective step names one with "destination"). A destination is reached in the scenes listed under reached_in: the marker is hidden there. Elsewhere the marker floats at the nearest way in: the world map zone (world: a place id in locations.json), the entrance to its building (entrance_scene and exit_scene, a door in that scene), or the gate of the scene when only the world map leads to it. The label is the name shown on the marker.
